context: Two teens trade weekend hangout plans between classes
purpose: Teach: ギャンブル/魔術/ランダム/グラフィック/炒め/満喫/ヒルズ/パキスタン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 週末さ、六本木ヒルズで新しいグラフィックアートの展示やってるの知ってる?
lines.en: Hey, did you know there's a new graphic art exhibition at Roppongi Hills this weekend?
lines.style: Casual teen tone, excited and inviting, slightly rising intonation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで?行きたい!でも俺、土曜は兄ちゃんと魔術師のショー見に行く約束しちゃった。
lines.en: Seriously? I want to go! But Saturday I already promised my brother I'd see a magician's show.
lines.style: Energetic boyish reaction, apologetic mid-sentence, casual masculine speech.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、じゃあ日曜は?お父さんに連れてってもらうパキスタン料理のお店、めっちゃ美味しいらしいよ。
lines.en: Aww, then how about Sunday? My dad's taking us to a Pakistani restaurant that's apparently super delicious.
lines.style: Disappointed then quickly enthusiastic, friendly persuasive teen voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね!カレーと野菜炒め大好きだし、絶対行く。
lines.en: Sounds great! I love curry and stir-fried vegetables, I'm totally going.
lines.style: Bright agreement, food-loving teen energy, decisive tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あとさ、駅前のゲーセンでランダムにカプセル出るやつ、新作出てるんだって。
lines.en: Also, that random capsule machine thing at the arcade by the station has new items out.
lines.style: Conversational teen chatter, sharing gossip-style update.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、ギャンブルみたいに当たり狙ってまた金使っちゃうやつだ…でも一回くらいやろうかな。
lines.en: Ugh, that's the kind of gamble where you keep spending money chasing wins... but maybe just once.
lines.style: Self-aware groan turning into weak resolve, playful teen humor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やろうやろう!カラオケも行って、日曜を満喫しようよ。
lines.en: Let's do it! Let's hit karaoke too and really enjoy Sunday to the fullest.
lines.style: Cheerful invitation, enthusiastic closing energy, warm friendship vibe.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解!じゃあ次の授業終わったら詳細決めよ。
lines.en: Got it! Let's figure out the details after the next class then.
lines.style: Quick agreement, casual male teen wrap-up before bell rings.
